goals.title: Goal management
goals.subtitle: (final verifiable goals, {count} in total; adds/edits notify the planner and revive the task)
goals.addPlaceholder: Add a goal, e.g. 'gain unauthorized access with an admin account'
goals.empty: No goals yet. Once added, the planner dispatches exploration intents from them and judges completion.

constraints.title: Operation constraints
constraints.subtitle: (bounds planner/worker exploration, {count} in total; changes take effect at the next planning round)
constraints.addPlaceholder: One operation constraint, e.g. 'test only the current port, do not scan other ports'
constraints.empty: No operation constraints yet. They are extracted automatically from the description/goal at task creation; you can also add, edit, or delete them here to bound which operations are allowed/denied.

tokens.title: LLM token usage
tokens.empty: No LLM usage yet (the task has made no calls, or records are still being written).

scope.title: Test scope
scope.subtitle: (coverage scope, not enforced, {count} in total)
scope.empty: No test scope yet; once added it serves as the asset coverage denominator.

blocked.title: Blocked/errored intents
blocked.subtitle: ({count} in total, re-runnable)
blocked.truncated: Only the first 20 are shown; click "Re-run all" to handle the remaining {count}.

intercept.title: Task-level asset intercept / allow
intercept.subtitle: (this task only, never global; block rules evaluate before allow rules, {count} in total)
intercept.empty: No task-level rules. A "Block" hit forbids testing; "Allow" is a whitelist — once configured, this task only permits assets that match an allow rule (no whitelist when unconfigured).
